bindingDecisions: The launch baseline is concept-based, not route-count based.
The original de-page-registry-seed.json must not be installed.
The source content is frozen at commit 43369d78e868238317571c30cf2131f4e75b857e.
New English/Norwegian P2 content may continue after the baseline without blocking German launch.
Target German slugs remain provisional until DE Wave 2 keyword and terminology work.
P0 and P1 pages in this baseline must be complete and approved before German indexation.
FDA-specific pages are outside the German launch scope.
Private account/app routes are outside the first German public-web scope.
Curated copy digests and implementation digests are tracked separately.
